<script>document.body.setAttribute("data-page","home");document.body.classList.remove("dlk-site-system");</script>
<style>
  #home-a {
    background: var(--proto-canvas);
    color: var(--proto-ink);
    font-family: var(--proto-font-sans);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-md);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-regular);
    line-height: var(--proto-leading-body);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-body);
    overflow-x: clip;
    max-width: 100%;
  }
  #home-a *,
  #home-a *::before,
  #home-a *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  #home-a img { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  #home-a a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  #home-a a.home-btn-primary,
  #home-a a.home-btn-primary:hover,
  #home-a a.home-btn-primary:focus-visible {
    color: #f4fbfa;
  }
  #home-a p,
  #home-a h1,
  #home-a h2,
  #home-a h3,
  #home-a h4,
  #home-a ul { margin: 0; }
  #home-a .hero-title {
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  #home-a .hero-subtitle,
  #home-a .hero-footnote {
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: auto;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #home-a .hero-subtitle {
    margin-top: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 42px;
  }
  #home-a .hero-footnote {
    margin-top: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.012em;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #home-a ul { padding: 0; list-style: none; }
  #home-a button,
  #home-a textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
  #home-a :where(a, button, textarea, summary, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
    outline: var(--proto-focus-ring);
    outline-offset: var(--proto-focus-offset);
  }
.home-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
.home-shell {
    width: min(100% - 2 * var(--proto-pad-inline), var(--proto-container-wide));
    margin-inline: auto;
    min-width: 0;
  }
.home-eyebrow {
    margin: 0 0 var(--proto-space-3);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-micro);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-label);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--proto-ink);
    line-height: var(--proto-leading-caption);
  }
.home-h2 {
    font-family: var(--proto-font-editorial);
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: var(--proto-size-xl);
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    line-height: 1.14;
  }
  .home-h2-major {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-display);
  }
  .home-editorial { background: var(--proto-editorial-paper); padding-top: var(--proto-space-section); }
  .home-h3 {
    font-family: var(--proto-font-display);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-lg);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-title);
    line-height: var(--proto-leading-title);
  }
  .home-lead {
    color: var(--proto-neutral-500);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    line-height: var(--proto-leading-body);
  }
.home-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: var(--proto-control-height);
    padding: var(--proto-control-pad-y) var(--proto-control-pad-x);
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    font-size: var(--proto-control-size);
    font-weight: var(--proto-control-weight);
    line-height: 1.2;
    text-align: center;
    white-space: normal;
    transition: background var(--proto-duration) var(--proto-ease),
                color var(--proto-duration) var(--proto-ease),
                border-color var(--proto-duration) var(--proto-ease);
  }
  .home-btn-primary {
    background: var(--proto-teal-700);
    color: #f4fbfa;
    border-color: var(--proto-teal-700);
  }
  .home-cta .home-btn-primary,
  .home-cta .home-btn-primary:hover,
  .home-cta .home-btn-primary:focus-visible {
    background: var(--proto-ink);
    color: #f7f8f8;
    border-color: var(--proto-ink);
  }
  .home-btn-primary:hover,
  .home-btn-primary:focus-visible {
    background: var(--proto-teal-800);
    color: #f4fbfa;
    border-color: var(--proto-teal-800);
  }
  .home-btn-ghost {
    background: var(--proto-plate);
    color: var(--proto-ink);
    border-color: var(--proto-neutral-300);
  }
  .home-btn-ghost:hover,
  .home-btn-ghost:focus-visible {
    background: var(--proto-teal-50);
    color: var(--proto-teal-800);
    border-color: var(--proto-teal-600);
  }
.home-index {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: var(--proto-space-2) var(--proto-space-4);
    padding: var(--proto-space-5) 0 var(--proto-space-3);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--proto-ink);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-micro);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-index);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--proto-ink);
  }
  .home-index > span:first-child {
    flex: 1 1 12rem;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
  }
  .home-index-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .home-index-end { color: var(--proto-neutral-500); }
  @media (max-width: 767px) {
    .home-index-end { display: none; }
  }
.home-split-head {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    padding: var(--proto-space-4) 0 var(--proto-space-6);
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .home-split-head {
      grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
      gap: var(--proto-space-6);
      align-items: end;
      padding: var(--proto-space-5) 0 var(--proto-space-6);
    }
  }
.home-media {
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-photo);
    background: var(--proto-neutral-100);
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .home-media img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
  }
/* ---- trust : hairline instrument rail ---- */
  .home-trust {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    padding: var(--proto-space-6) 0;
    background: var(--proto-canvas);
  }
  .home-trust-grid {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
  }
  .home-trust-item {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
    gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    align-items: start;
    padding: var(--proto-space-5) 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .home-trust-item:first-child { border-top: 0; padding-top: 0; }
  .home-trust-ico {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    border: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    color: var(--proto-ink);
    background: var(--proto-canvas);
  }
  .home-trust-ico svg { display: block; }
  .home-trust-kicker {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-micro);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-label);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }
  .home-trust-item h4 {
    font-family: var(--proto-font-display);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-display);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-md);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-title);
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }
  .home-trust-item p {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    color: var(--proto-neutral-500);
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .home-trust-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 0;
    }
    .home-trust-item {
      padding: var(--proto-space-5);
      border-top: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    }
    .home-trust-item:nth-child(odd) {
      border-right: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
      padding-left: 0;
    }
    .home-trust-item:nth-child(even) { padding-right: var(--proto-space-5); }
    .home-trust-item:nth-child(-n+2) { padding-top: 0; }
    .home-trust-item:nth-child(n+3) { padding-bottom: 0; border-bottom: 0; }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1024px) {
    .home-trust { padding: var(--proto-space-7) 0; }
    .home-trust-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
    .home-trust-item {
      padding: 0 var(--proto-space-5);
      border: 0;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    }
    .home-trust-item:nth-child(odd) { padding-left: var(--proto-space-5); }
    .home-trust-item:first-child { padding-left: 0; }
    .home-trust-item:last-child {
      border-right: 0;
      padding-right: var(--proto-space-5);
    }
  }
/* ---- 01 advantage : photo + plate | stacked rows ---- */
  .home-adv {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-5);
    padding-bottom: var(--proto-space-section);
  }
  .home-adv-hero { min-width: 0; }
  .home-adv-hero .home-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
  .home-plate {
    margin-top: var(--proto-space-4);
    background: var(--proto-plate);
    border: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    padding: var(--proto-space-5);
  }
  .home-plate .home-idx,
  .home-adv-row .home-idx {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-micro);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-index);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: var(--proto-space-2);
  }
  .home-plate h3,
  .home-adv-row h3 { margin: 0 0 var(--proto-space-2); }
  .home-plate p,
  .home-adv-row p {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    color: var(--proto-neutral-500);
  }
  .home-adv-list {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .home-adv-row {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0;
    color: inherit;
  }
  .home-adv-row .home-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
  .home-adv-row .home-idx,
  .home-adv-row .home-chip { display: none; }
  .home-chip {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    margin: 0 0 var(--proto-space-2);
  }
  .home-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    left: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    bottom: 10px;
    background: var(--proto-plate-soft);
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    padding: 0.65rem 0.8rem;
  }
  .home-overlay span {
    display: block;
    font-size: var(--proto-size-micro);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-label);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .home-overlay b {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 0.2rem;
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-semibold);
  }
  .home-adv-row:hover .home-overlay,
  .home-adv-row:focus-within .home-overlay,
  .home-path:hover .home-overlay,
  .home-path:focus-within .home-overlay,
  .home-story:hover .home-overlay,
  .home-story:focus-within .home-overlay {
    background: var(--proto-teal-50);
  }
  .home-adv-row:hover .home-media img,
  .home-adv-row:focus-within .home-media img,
  .home-path:hover .home-media img,
  .home-path:focus-within .home-media img {
    filter: brightness(1.03);
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .home-adv-row {
      grid-template-columns: 8.5rem 1fr;
      align-items: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
      border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
      padding: var(--proto-space-3);
      gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    }
    .home-adv-row .home-media { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; }
    .home-adv-row .home-overlay { display: none; }
    .home-adv-row .home-idx,
    .home-adv-row .home-chip { display: block; }
    .home-adv-row:hover,
    .home-adv-row:focus-within { background: var(--proto-teal-50); border-color: var(--proto-teal-600); }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1024px) {
    .home-adv {
      grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
      gap: var(--proto-space-5);
      align-items: stretch;
    }
    .home-adv-hero { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .home-adv-hero .home-media { aspect-ratio: auto; flex: 1; min-height: 28rem; }
    .home-plate {
      position: absolute;
      left: 16px;
      right: 16px;
      bottom: 16px;
      margin: 0;
      border: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(12, 15, 15, 0.12);
    }
    .home-adv-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--proto-space-4);
    }
    .home-adv-row { flex: 1; }
  }
/* ---- 02 solutions : 3-up photo + type ---- */
  .home-paths {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-6);
    padding-bottom: var(--proto-space-section);
  }
  .home-path {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    color: inherit;
    min-width: 0;
  }
  .home-path .home-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; }
  .home-path-copy {
    padding-top: var(--proto-space-4);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--proto-space-3);
    flex: 1;
  }
  .home-path-copy p { font-size: var(--proto-size-sm); color: var(--proto-neutral-500); }
  .home-spec {
    display: grid;
    gap: 0;
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-medium);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
  }
  .home-spec li {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.55rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 0.55rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
  }
  .home-spec li::before {
    content: "";
    width: 0.4rem;
    height: 0.4rem;
    margin-top: 0.45rem;
    background: var(--proto-ink);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .home-path .home-btn { align-self: flex-start; margin-top: auto; }
  .home-path:hover .home-btn-primary,
  .home-path:focus-within .home-btn-primary {
    background: var(--proto-teal-800);
    color: #f4fbfa;
    border-color: var(--proto-pill-a-hover-line);
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .home-paths { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .home-paths .home-path:last-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    .home-paths .home-path:last-child .home-media { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1024px) {
    .home-paths { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
    .home-paths .home-path:last-child { grid-column: auto; }
    .home-path .home-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }
    .home-paths .home-path:last-child .home-media { aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; }
  }
/* ---- CTA : photo + white plates ---- */
  .home-cta {
    position: relative;
    background: var(--proto-neutral-100);
  }
  .home-cta-media { height: 22rem; }
  .home-cta-media img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
  }
  .home-cta-lower {
    display: grid;
    gap: var(--proto-space-3);
    margin-top: -4.5rem;
    padding: 0 var(--proto-pad-inline) var(--proto-space-section);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  .home-cta-titleplate,
  .home-cta-action {
    background: var(--proto-plate-soft);
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    padding: var(--proto-space-5);
  }
  .home-cta-titleplate h2 { padding-bottom: 1.15rem; }
  .home-cta-titleplate p {
    color: var(--proto-neutral-500);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    line-height: 1.7;
    padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }
  .home-cta-action h4 {
    font-family: var(--proto-font-display);
    font-weight: var(--proto-weight-display);
    font-size: var(--proto-size-lg);
    letter-spacing: var(--proto-track-title);
    padding-top: 0.35rem;
    padding-bottom: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }
  .home-cta-action > p {
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
    color: var(--proto-neutral-500);
    line-height: 1.7;
    padding-bottom: 1.35rem;
  }
  .home-cta-btns {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--proto-space-2);
    margin-bottom: var(--proto-space-5);
  }
  .home-cta-btns .home-btn { width: 100%; }
  .home-cta-points {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    font-size: var(--proto-size-sm);
  }
  @media (min-width: 480px) {
    .home-cta-points { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  }
  .home-cta-points li {
    border: 1px solid var(--proto-neutral-200);
    border-radius: var(--proto-radius-lg);
    padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem;
    background: var(--proto-plate);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
  }
  @media (min-width: 768px) {
    .home-cta-media { height: 34rem; }
    .home-cta-lower {
      margin-top: -8rem;
      width: min(100% - 2 * var(--proto-pad-inline), var(--proto-container-wide));
      margin-inline: auto;
      padding-inline: 0;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      align-items: end;
    }
  }
  @media (min-width: 1024px) {
    .home-cta-media { height: 38rem; }
    .home-cta-lower {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 2.25rem;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: min(100% - 2 * var(--proto-pad-inline), var(--proto-container-wide));
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }
    .home-cta { padding-bottom: 0; }
  }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    #home-a *,
    #home-a *::before,
    #home-a *::after {
      transition: none !important;
      filter: none !important;
    }
  }
</style>
<div class="app-refinement lc-block" id="home-a">
<style>
.hero-ops, .hero-cinematic,
  .hero-ops *, .hero-ops *::before, .hero-ops *::after,
  .hero-cinematic *, .hero-cinematic *::before, .hero-cinematic *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .hero-ops p, .hero-cinematic p, .hero-cinematic h1 { margin: 0; }
  .hero-ops a, .hero-cinematic a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  #home-a .hero-cinematic a.hero-capsule {
    color: #f4f7f6 !important;
    background: rgba(11, 31, 51, 0.72);
  }
  #home-a .hero-cinematic a.hero-capsule:hover,
  #home-a .hero-cinematic a.hero-capsule:focus-visible {
    color: #ffffff !important;
    background: rgba(12, 127, 115, 0.72);
  }
  .hero-ops :where(a, button, summary, [tabindex]):focus-visible,
  .hero-cinematic :where(a, button, textarea, [tabindex]):focus-visible {
    outline: var(--hero-focus, 3px solid rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.55));
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
/* ---- operations strip (live .lk-topbar) ---- */
  .hero-ops {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
    background: var(--hero-ops-bg, #ffffff);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hero-ops-line, #dfe7ec);
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--hero-ops-fg, #64748b);
  }
  .hero-ops-shell { width: min(1240px, calc(100% - 48px)); margin: 0 auto; }
  .hero-ops-desktop {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 10px 0;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .hero-ops-lead { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .hero-ops a {
    color: var(--hero-ops-link, #475569);
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .hero-ops a:hover { color: var(--hero-ops-link-hover, #0d9488); }
  .hero-ops-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-family: var(--hero-ops-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace);
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--hero-ops-pill-fg, #0d9488);
    background: var(--hero-ops-pill-bg, rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.08));
    border: 1px solid var(--hero-ops-pill-border, rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.25));
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .hero-ops-dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--hero-ops-dot, #13b8a6);
    box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--hero-ops-dot, #13b8a6);
  }
  .hero-ops-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .hero-ops-lead { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px; }
  }
.hero-ops-mobile { display: none; }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .hero-ops {
      background: var(--hero-ops-bg-mobile, #f6f9fa);
      border-bottom-color: var(--hero-ops-line-mobile, #e2e9ec);
    }
    .hero-ops-desktop { display: none; }
    .hero-ops-mobile {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var root = document.getElementById("home-stages");
  if (!root) return;
  var tabs = root.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
  var panels = root.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]');
  if (!tabs.length || tabs.length !== panels.length) return;

  var list = root.querySelector('[role="tablist"]');

  function indexFromHash() {
    var m = (location.hash || "").match(/^#stage-([1-5])$/i);
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) - 1 : 0;
  }

  function revealTab(tab) {
    if (!list || !tab) return;
    var listRect = list.getBoundingClientRect();
    var tabRect = tab.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (tabRect.left < listRect.left) {
      list.scrollLeft += tabRect.left - listRect.left;
    } else if (tabRect.right > listRect.right) {
      list.scrollLeft += tabRect.right - listRect.right;
    }
  }

  function select(index, updateHash) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= tabs.length) return;
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      var on = i === index;
      tabs[i].setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
      tabs[i].tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
      if (on) panels[i].classList.add("is-active");
      else panels[i].classList.remove("is-active");
    }
    revealTab(tabs[index]);
    if (updateHash && window.history && typeof history.replaceState === "function") {
      try {
        history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search + "#stage-" + (index + 1));
      } catch (err) {}
    }
  }

  select(indexFromHash(), false);
  root.classList.add("is-tabs");
  revealTab(tabs[indexFromHash()]);

  function onKey(event, index) {
    var next = index;
    var key = event.key;
    if (key === "ArrowRight" || key === "ArrowDown") {
      next = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
    } else if (key === "ArrowLeft" || key === "ArrowUp") {
      next = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
    } else if (key === "Home") {
      next = 0;
    } else if (key === "End") {
      next = tabs.length - 1;
    } else if (key === "Enter" || key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault();
      select(index, true);
      return;
    } else {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    tabs[next].focus();
    select(next, true);
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(tabs, function (tab, index) {
    tab.addEventListener("click", function () {
      select(index, true);
    });
    tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      onKey(event, index);
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
    select(indexFromHash(), false);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var section = document.getElementById("testimonials");
  if (!section) return;
  var track = section.querySelector(".home-stories");
  var stories = track
    ? Array.prototype.slice.call(track.querySelectorAll(".home-story"))
    : [];
  var prev = document.getElementById("testi-prev");
  var next = document.getElementById("testi-next");
  var dots = Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll(".home-stor-dot"));
  if (!track || stories.length < 2 || !prev || !next) return;

  var n = stories.length;
  var index = 0;
  var animating = false;
  var pending = "";
  var paused = false;
  var timer = 0;
  var finishTimer = 0;
  var SLIDE_MS = 360;
  var DWELL_MS = 4000;
  var noauto = false;
  try {
    noauto = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("noauto") === "1";
  } catch (e) {
    noauto = false;
  }
  var mq = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 0px)");
  var reduceMq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  var hoverMq = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover)");

  function stepPx() {
    var card = stories[0];
    if (!card) return 0;
    var gap = 0;
    if (window.getComputedStyle) {
      gap = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(track).columnGap || window.getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 0;
    }
    return card.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
  }

  function carouselOn() {
    return mq.matches && section.classList.contains("is-stor-carousel");
  }

  function autoAllowed() {
    return !noauto && !reduceMq.matches && mq.matches && !paused;
  }

  function applyOrder() {
    var i;
    var ord;
    var el;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
      el = stories[i];
      ord = (i - index + n) % n;
      if (mq.matches) {
        el.style.order = String(ord);
        if (ord === 0) el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
        else el.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      } else {
        el.style.order = "";
        el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
      }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < dots.length; i += 1) {
      if (i === index) dots[i].classList.add("is-on");
      else dots[i].classList.remove("is-on");
    }
  }

  function stopTimer() {
    if (timer) {
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      timer = 0;
    }
    section.classList.remove("is-stor-play");
  }

  function restartProgress() {
    section.classList.remove("is-stor-play");
    if (!autoAllowed()) return;
    void section.offsetWidth;
    section.classList.add("is-stor-play");
  }

  function startTimer() {
    stopTimer();
    if (!autoAllowed()) return;
    restartProgress();
    timer = window.setInterval(function () {
      go(1);
    }, DWELL_MS);
  }

  function finishAnim() {
    if (finishTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
      finishTimer = 0;
    }
    if (!animating) return;
    if (pending === "next") {
      index = (index + 1) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
    }
    pending = "";
    animating = false;
    applyOrder();
    if (!paused) startTimer();
  }

  function armFinish() {
    if (finishTimer) window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
    finishTimer = window.setTimeout(finishAnim, SLIDE_MS + 120);
  }

  function go(dir) {
    if (!carouselOn()) return;
    if (animating) return;
    dir = dir < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    stopTimer();

    if (reduceMq.matches) {
      index = (index + dir + n) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      applyOrder();
      if (!paused) startTimer();
      return;
    }

    animating = true;
    if (dir > 0) {
      pending = "next";
      track.style.transition = "transform " + SLIDE_MS + "ms var(--proto-ease)";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + stepPx() + "px)";
    } else {
      pending = "prev";
      var prevIndex = (index - 1 + n) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      stories.forEach(function (el, i) {
        el.style.order = String((i - prevIndex + n) % n);
      });
      track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + stepPx() + "px)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
      index = prevIndex;
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transition = "transform " + SLIDE_MS + "ms var(--proto-ease)";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
    }
    armFinish();
  }

  function onStep(dir) {
    return function (event) {
      if (!carouselOn()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.stopImmediatePropagation) event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      event.stopPropagation();
      go(dir);
    };
  }

  function pauseAuto() {
    paused = true;
    stopTimer();
  }

  function resumeAuto() {
    paused = false;
    if (!animating) startTimer();
  }

  function syncMode() {
    animating = false;
    pending = "";
    if (finishTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
      finishTimer = 0;
    }
    if (mq.matches) {
      section.classList.add("is-stor-carousel");
      if (noauto || reduceMq.matches) section.classList.add("is-stor-static");
      else section.classList.remove("is-stor-static");
      track.style.transition = "none";
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
      startTimer();
    } else {
      section.classList.remove("is-stor-carousel", "is-stor-play", "is-stor-static");
      stopTimer();
      stories.forEach(function (el) {
        el.style.order = "";
        el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
      });
      track.style.transform = "";
      track.style.transition = "";
    }
  }

  prev.addEventListener("click", onStep(-1), true);
  next.addEventListener("click", onStep(1), true);

  track.addEventListener("transitionend", function (event) {
    if (event.target !== track) return;
    if (event.propertyName && event.propertyName !== "transform") return;
    finishAnim();
  });

  if (hoverMq.matches) {
    section.addEventListener("mouseenter", pauseAuto);
    section.addEventListener("mouseleave", resumeAuto);
  }
  section.addEventListener("focusin", pauseAuto);
  section.addEventListener("focusout", function (event) {
    if (!section.contains(event.relatedTarget)) resumeAuto();
  });
  section.addEventListener("touchstart", pauseAuto, { passive: true });
  section.addEventListener("touchend", resumeAuto, { passive: true });
  section.addEventListener("touchcancel", resumeAuto, { passive: true });

  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", syncMode);
  else mq.addListener(syncMode);
  if (reduceMq.addEventListener) reduceMq.addEventListener("change", syncMode);
  else reduceMq.addListener(syncMode);

  syncMode();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('#home-a [data-adv-root]');
  if (!root) return;
  var choices = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-adv-choice]'));
  var photos = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.home-adv-photo'));
  function select(index) {
    choices.forEach(function (choice, i) {
      var active = i === index;
      choice.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      choice.querySelector('.home-adv-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(active));
      var detail = choice.querySelector('.home-adv-detail');
      detail.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      detail.hidden = !active;
    });
    photos.forEach(function (photo, i) {
      var active = i === index;
      photo.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      photo.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    });
  }
  root.classList.add('is-ready');
  select(0);
  root.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    var target = event.target.closest('[data-adv-select]');
    if (target && root.contains(target)) select(Number(target.dataset.advSelect));
  });
  root.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
    var target = event.target.closest('.home-adv-trigger');
    if (!target) return;
    var direction = event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0;
    if (!direction) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    var next = (Number(target.dataset.advSelect) + direction + choices.length) % choices.length;
    select(next);
    choices[next].querySelector('.home-adv-trigger').focus();
  });
})();
</script>

/* Shared native scroll controls; cards remain ordinary, fully readable page content. */
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-capability-track]').forEach(function (track) {
    var controls = track.nextElementSibling;
    var previous = controls.querySelector('[data-capability-step="-1"]');
    var next = controls.querySelector('[data-capability-step="1"]');
    var cards = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('[data-capability-card]'));
    function update() {
      var max = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
      controls.hidden = max <= 1;
      previous.disabled = track.scrollLeft <= 1;
      next.disabled = track.scrollLeft >= max - 1;
    }
    function move(delta) {
      var step = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 16;
      track.scrollBy({left:delta * step,behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth'});
    }
    previous.addEventListener('click',function () { move(-1); });
    next.addEventListener('click',function () { move(1); });
    track.addEventListener('keydown',function (event) {
      if (event.target !== track || !['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(event.key)) return;
      event.preventDefault(); move(event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1);
    });
    track.addEventListener('scroll',update,{passive:true});
    new ResizeObserver(update).observe(track); update();
  });
})();

<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var root = document.getElementById("home-stages");
  if (!root) return;
  var tabs = root.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]');
  var panels = root.querySelectorAll('[role="tabpanel"]');
  if (!tabs.length || tabs.length !== panels.length) return;

  var list = root.querySelector('[role="tablist"]');

  function indexFromHash() {
    var m = (location.hash || "").match(/^#stage-([1-5])$/i);
    return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) - 1 : 0;
  }

  function revealTab(tab) {
    if (!list || !tab) return;
    var listRect = list.getBoundingClientRect();
    var tabRect = tab.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (tabRect.left < listRect.left) {
      list.scrollLeft += tabRect.left - listRect.left;
    } else if (tabRect.right > listRect.right) {
      list.scrollLeft += tabRect.right - listRect.right;
    }
  }

  function select(index, updateHash) {
    if (index < 0 || index >= tabs.length) return;
    var i;
    for (i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      var on = i === index;
      tabs[i].setAttribute("aria-selected", on ? "true" : "false");
      tabs[i].tabIndex = on ? 0 : -1;
      if (on) panels[i].classList.add("is-active");
      else panels[i].classList.remove("is-active");
    }
    revealTab(tabs[index]);
    if (updateHash && window.history && typeof history.replaceState === "function") {
      try {
        history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + location.search + "#stage-" + (index + 1));
      } catch (err) {}
    }
  }

  select(indexFromHash(), false);
  root.classList.add("is-tabs");
  revealTab(tabs[indexFromHash()]);

  function onKey(event, index) {
    var next = index;
    var key = event.key;
    if (key === "ArrowRight" || key === "ArrowDown") {
      next = (index + 1) % tabs.length;
    } else if (key === "ArrowLeft" || key === "ArrowUp") {
      next = (index - 1 + tabs.length) % tabs.length;
    } else if (key === "Home") {
      next = 0;
    } else if (key === "End") {
      next = tabs.length - 1;
    } else if (key === "Enter" || key === " ") {
      event.preventDefault();
      select(index, true);
      return;
    } else {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    tabs[next].focus();
    select(next, true);
  }

  Array.prototype.forEach.call(tabs, function (tab, index) {
    tab.addEventListener("click", function () {
      select(index, true);
    });
    tab.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      onKey(event, index);
    });
  });

  window.addEventListener("hashchange", function () {
    select(indexFromHash(), false);
  });
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  var section = document.getElementById("testimonials");
  if (!section) return;
  var track = section.querySelector(".home-stories");
  var stories = track
    ? Array.prototype.slice.call(track.querySelectorAll(".home-story"))
    : [];
  var prev = document.getElementById("testi-prev");
  var next = document.getElementById("testi-next");
  var dots = Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll(".home-stor-dot"));
  if (!track || stories.length < 2 || !prev || !next) return;

  var n = stories.length;
  var index = 0;
  var animating = false;
  var pending = "";
  var paused = false;
  var timer = 0;
  var finishTimer = 0;
  var SLIDE_MS = 360;
  var DWELL_MS = 4000;
  var noauto = false;
  try {
    noauto = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("noauto") === "1";
  } catch (e) {
    noauto = false;
  }
  var mq = window.matchMedia("(min-width: 0px)");
  var reduceMq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
  var hoverMq = window.matchMedia("(hover: hover)");

  function stepPx() {
    var card = stories[0];
    if (!card) return 0;
    var gap = 0;
    if (window.getComputedStyle) {
      gap = parseFloat(window.getComputedStyle(track).columnGap || window.getComputedStyle(track).gap) || 0;
    }
    return card.getBoundingClientRect().width + gap;
  }

  function carouselOn() {
    return mq.matches && section.classList.contains("is-stor-carousel");
  }

  function autoAllowed() {
    return !noauto && !reduceMq.matches && mq.matches && !paused;
  }

  function applyOrder() {
    var i;
    var ord;
    var el;
    for (i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
      el = stories[i];
      ord = (i - index + n) % n;
      if (mq.matches) {
        el.style.order = String(ord);
        if (ord === 0) el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
        else el.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      } else {
        el.style.order = "";
        el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
      }
    }
    for (i = 0; i < dots.length; i += 1) {
      if (i === index) dots[i].classList.add("is-on");
      else dots[i].classList.remove("is-on");
    }
  }

  function stopTimer() {
    if (timer) {
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      timer = 0;
    }
    section.classList.remove("is-stor-play");
  }

  function restartProgress() {
    section.classList.remove("is-stor-play");
    if (!autoAllowed()) return;
    void section.offsetWidth;
    section.classList.add("is-stor-play");
  }

  function startTimer() {
    stopTimer();
    if (!autoAllowed()) return;
    restartProgress();
    timer = window.setInterval(function () {
      go(1);
    }, DWELL_MS);
  }

  function finishAnim() {
    if (finishTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
      finishTimer = 0;
    }
    if (!animating) return;
    if (pending === "next") {
      index = (index + 1) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
    }
    pending = "";
    animating = false;
    applyOrder();
    if (!paused) startTimer();
  }

  function armFinish() {
    if (finishTimer) window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
    finishTimer = window.setTimeout(finishAnim, SLIDE_MS + 120);
  }

  function go(dir) {
    if (!carouselOn()) return;
    if (animating) return;
    dir = dir < 0 ? -1 : 1;
    stopTimer();

    if (reduceMq.matches) {
      index = (index + dir + n) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      applyOrder();
      if (!paused) startTimer();
      return;
    }

    animating = true;
    if (dir > 0) {
      pending = "next";
      track.style.transition = "transform " + SLIDE_MS + "ms var(--proto-ease)";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + stepPx() + "px)";
    } else {
      pending = "prev";
      var prevIndex = (index - 1 + n) % n;
      track.style.transition = "none";
      stories.forEach(function (el, i) {
        el.style.order = String((i - prevIndex + n) % n);
      });
      track.style.transform = "translateX(-" + stepPx() + "px)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
      index = prevIndex;
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transition = "transform " + SLIDE_MS + "ms var(--proto-ease)";
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
    }
    armFinish();
  }

  function onStep(dir) {
    return function (event) {
      if (!carouselOn()) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (event.stopImmediatePropagation) event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      event.stopPropagation();
      go(dir);
    };
  }

  function pauseAuto() {
    paused = true;
    stopTimer();
  }

  function resumeAuto() {
    paused = false;
    if (!animating) startTimer();
  }

  function syncMode() {
    animating = false;
    pending = "";
    if (finishTimer) {
      window.clearTimeout(finishTimer);
      finishTimer = 0;
    }
    if (mq.matches) {
      section.classList.add("is-stor-carousel");
      if (noauto || reduceMq.matches) section.classList.add("is-stor-static");
      else section.classList.remove("is-stor-static");
      track.style.transition = "none";
      applyOrder();
      track.style.transform = "translateX(0)";
      void track.offsetWidth;
      startTimer();
    } else {
      section.classList.remove("is-stor-carousel", "is-stor-play", "is-stor-static");
      stopTimer();
      stories.forEach(function (el) {
        el.style.order = "";
        el.removeAttribute("aria-hidden");
      });
      track.style.transform = "";
      track.style.transition = "";
    }
  }

  prev.addEventListener("click", onStep(-1), true);
  next.addEventListener("click", onStep(1), true);

  track.addEventListener("transitionend", function (event) {
    if (event.target !== track) return;
    if (event.propertyName && event.propertyName !== "transform") return;
    finishAnim();
  });

  if (hoverMq.matches) {
    section.addEventListener("mouseenter", pauseAuto);
    section.addEventListener("mouseleave", resumeAuto);
  }
  section.addEventListener("focusin", pauseAuto);
  section.addEventListener("focusout", function (event) {
    if (!section.contains(event.relatedTarget)) resumeAuto();
  });
  section.addEventListener("touchstart", pauseAuto, { passive: true });
  section.addEventListener("touchend", resumeAuto, { passive: true });
  section.addEventListener("touchcancel", resumeAuto, { passive: true });

  if (mq.addEventListener) mq.addEventListener("change", syncMode);
  else mq.addListener(syncMode);
  if (reduceMq.addEventListener) reduceMq.addEventListener("change", syncMode);
  else reduceMq.addListener(syncMode);

  syncMode();
})();
</script>

(function () {
  var root = document.querySelector('#home-a [data-adv-root]');
  if (!root) return;
  var choices = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('[data-adv-choice]'));
  var photos = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.home-adv-photo'));
  function select(index) {
    choices.forEach(function (choice, i) {
      var active = i === index;
      choice.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      choice.querySelector('.home-adv-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(active));
      var detail = choice.querySelector('.home-adv-detail');
      detail.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      detail.hidden = !active;
    });
    photos.forEach(function (photo, i) {
      var active = i === index;
      photo.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
      photo.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(active));
    });
  }
  root.classList.add('is-ready');
  select(0);
  root.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
    var target = event.target.closest('[data-adv-select]');
    if (target && root.contains(target)) select(Number(target.dataset.advSelect));
  });
  root.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
    var target = event.target.closest('.home-adv-trigger');
    if (!target) return;
    var direction = event.key === 'ArrowRight' || event.key === 'ArrowDown' ? 1 : event.key === 'ArrowLeft' || event.key === 'ArrowUp' ? -1 : 0;
    if (!direction) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    var next = (Number(target.dataset.advSelect) + direction + choices.length) % choices.length;
    select(next);
    choices[next].querySelector('.home-adv-trigger').focus();
  });
})();
</script>

/* Shared native scroll controls; cards remain ordinary, fully readable page content. */
(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-capability-track]').forEach(function (track) {
    var controls = track.nextElementSibling;
    var previous = controls.querySelector('[data-capability-step="-1"]');
    var next = controls.querySelector('[data-capability-step="1"]');
    var cards = Array.from(track.querySelectorAll('[data-capability-card]'));
    function update() {
      var max = track.scrollWidth - track.clientWidth;
      controls.hidden = max <= 1;
      previous.disabled = track.scrollLeft <= 1;
      next.disabled = track.scrollLeft >= max - 1;
    }
    function move(delta) {
      var step = cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width + 16;
      track.scrollBy({left:delta * step,behavior:window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches ? 'auto' : 'smooth'});
    }
    previous.addEventListener('click',function () { move(-1); });
    next.addEventListener('click',function () { move(1); });
    track.addEventListener('keydown',function (event) {
      if (event.target !== track || !['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(event.key)) return;
      event.preventDefault(); move(event.key === 'ArrowRight' ? 1 : -1);
    });
    track.addEventListener('scroll',update,{passive:true});
    new ResizeObserver(update).observe(track); update();
  });
})();

<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

</script>

content:
<!--
  de-linker Blog Posts Index Dynamic Template v1
  Deploy: LiveCanvas Dynamic Templates → Blog Index → Edit HTML
  Target URL: https://de-linker.com/blog/
  Rendering: scoped inline CSS, no JS required
  Pagination: 12 posts per page via [lc_the_pagination]
-->
<tangible class="live-refresh">
<section id="tv-blog-index-v1">
  <style>
    :root{--lk-navy:#0b1f33;--lk-blue:#163a5f;--lk-teal:#13b8a6;--lk-teal-text:#0c7f73;--lk-green:#7bd14b;--lk-ink:#172636;--lk-muted:#5f6b7c;--lk-line:#dfe7ec;--lk-soft:#f5f8fa;--lk-footer:#071726;--lk-grad-deep:linear-gradient(145deg,#0b2439,#0f5155);--lk-shadow-btn:0 10px 24px rgba(19,184,166,.24);--lk-shadow-panel:0 30px 70px rgba(21,53,77,.14)}
    /* ============================================================
       Linker Blog Posts Index Dynamic Template v1 (DS v1)
       All selectors scoped to #tv-blog-index-v1
       No Bootstrap/Picostrap/DaisyUI component classes.
       No external image URLs.
    ============================================================ */
    /* --- root / shared --- */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 { font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; background: #ffffff; color: var(--lk-ink); }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-container { max-width: 1320px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2rem); }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-section-pad { padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); }
    /* --- shared typography (DS v1 eyebrow pattern; JetBrains Mono retired) --- */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-mono-eyebrow {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em; line-height: 1.4;
      text-transform: uppercase; color: #0c7f73;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-mono-eyebrow:before {
      content: ""; width: 34px; height: 2px; background: var(--lk-teal); flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-card-cat-mono {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.64rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-card-cat-mono-muted {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--lk-muted);
    }
    /* ============================================================
       MODULE 1 — BLOG MASTHEAD
       Frosted technical hero shell with glass panel.
     ============================================================ */
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead {
       position: relative; overflow: hidden;
       padding-block: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5.5rem) clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
       background: linear-gradient(120deg,#f8fbfd 0%,#eef6f6 52%,#f7fbf5 100%);
       border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lk-line);
     }
     /* frosted glow behind glass */
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead::before {
       content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
       background:none;
     }
     /* subtle grid-line texture */
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead::after {
       content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
       background-image:
         linear-gradient(rgba(16,32,51,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px),
         linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(16,32,51,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px);
       background-size: 64px 64px;
       -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 30%, black 30%, transparent 78%);
       mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 70% at 50% 30%, black 30%, transparent 78%);
     }
     /* glass panel wrapping content */
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-grid {
       position: relative; z-index: 1;
       display: grid; gap: 2.5rem;
       background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
       backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
       -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px);
       border: 1px solid #dbe6ea;
       border-radius: 20px;
       box-shadow: var(--lk-shadow-panel);
       padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
     }
     @media (min-width: 1024px) {
       #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-grid {
         grid-template-columns: 8fr 4fr; align-items: end;
         padding: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
       }
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-eyebrow {
       display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
       margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
       font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
       font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800;
       letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
       color: var(--lk-teal-text);
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-eyebrow:before {
       content: ""; width: 34px; height: 2px; background: var(--lk-teal); flex-shrink: 0;
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-title {
       margin: 0;
       font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); font-weight:560;
       letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.05;
       max-width: 22ch; color: var(--lk-navy);
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-lead {
       margin: 1.25rem 0 0;
       max-width: 38rem;
       font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65;
       color: var(--lk-muted);
     }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-lead { font-size: 1.125rem; }
    }
    /* masthead chips */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-chips {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-top: 1.25rem;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-masthead-chips .tv-blog-chip {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center;
      padding: 0.375rem 0.875rem;
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: #ffffff;
      border: 1px solid rgba(19,184,166,0.28);
      color: var(--lk-navy);
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600;
    }
    /* masthead search */
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-search {
       display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.75rem;
       border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--lk-teal); padding-bottom: 0.625rem;
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-search input {
       flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; outline: none;
       font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
       font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--lk-navy);
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-search input::placeholder { color: var(--lk-muted); }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-search button {
       display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
       width: 2.5rem; height: 2.5rem; border-radius: 50%;
       border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--lk-teal-text); cursor: pointer;
       transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
     }
     #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-masthead .tv-blog-search button:hover {
       background: var(--lk-teal); color: var(--lk-navy);
     }
    /* ============================================================
       MODULE 2 — LATEST ARTICLES SPLIT
    ============================================================ */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest {
      background: var(--lk-soft);
      padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-latest-grid {
      display: grid; gap: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-latest-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 6fr 5fr;
      }
    }
    /* section heading */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 .tv-blog-section-heading {
      margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    /* featured card (left) */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-card {
      border-radius:16px; overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--lk-line); background: #ffffff;
      box-shadow:none;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-card:hover {
      transform:none;
      box-shadow:none;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-img {
      position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-img img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
      transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-card:hover .tv-blog-featured-img img {
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-img .tv-blog-img-fallback {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lk-navy) 0%, var(--lk-teal) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-img .tv-blog-img-fallback svg {
      width: 3rem; height: 3rem; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-body {
      padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.75rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-body { padding: 1.75rem 2rem 2rem; }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-meta {
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--lk-muted);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-title {
      margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-excerpt {
      margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
      font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--lk-muted);
      max-width: 38rem;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-link {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--lk-teal-text); text-decoration: none;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-featured-link:hover { color: #0a6d61; }
    /* compact list (right) */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-list {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--lk-line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lk-line);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-item {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem;
      padding-block: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lk-line);
      text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-title {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.0625rem, 2vw, 1.25rem); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--lk-navy);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-item:hover .tv-blog-compact-title {
      color: var(--lk-teal-text);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-arrow {
      flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 50%;
      border: 1px solid var(--lk-line); color: var(--lk-teal-text);
      transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s, color 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-compact-item:hover .tv-blog-compact-arrow {
      border-color: var(--lk-teal); background: var(--lk-teal); color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    /* --- project inquiry strip (between latest and practical) --- */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-strip {
      margin-top: 2rem;
      padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius:16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--lk-line); background: #ffffff;
      box-shadow:none;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-strip { padding: 1.25rem 1.75rem; }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-inner {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-inner {
        flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-label {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-inquiry-text {
      font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--lk-muted);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-btn-primary {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem;
      padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius:8px; border: none;
      background: var(--lk-teal); color: var(--lk-navy);
      box-shadow: var(--lk-shadow-btn);
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
      transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-latest .tv-blog-btn-primary:hover {
      background: #0fa996; transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    /* ============================================================
       MODULE 3 — PRACTICAL READING
    ============================================================ */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical {
      background: var(--lk-soft);
      padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-grid {
      display: grid; gap: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3.5rem);
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 6fr 5fr;
      }
    }
    /* compact with thumbnails (left column) */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-list {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--lk-line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lk-line);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item {
      display: grid; gap: 1rem; align-items: center;
      padding-block: 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lk-line);
      text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item {
        grid-template-columns: 120px 1fr auto;
      }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-thumb {
      position: relative; height: 5.5rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius:8px;
      background: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-thumb { height: 5rem; }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-thumb img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
      transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item:hover .tv-blog-practical-thumb img {
      transform: scale(1.03);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-thumb .tv-blog-img-fallback-sm {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lk-navy) 0%, var(--lk-teal) 100%);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-title {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.8vw, 1.125rem); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.25; color: var(--lk-navy);
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item:hover .tv-blog-practical-title {
      color: var(--lk-teal-text);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-arrow {
      display: none;
    }
    @media (min-width: 640px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-arrow {
        flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        width: 2.25rem; height: 2.25rem; border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--lk-teal); color: var(--lk-navy);
        transition: background 0.2s;
      }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-practical-item:hover .tv-blog-practical-arrow {
      background: var(--lk-teal);
    }
    /* guide card (right column) */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-card {
      border-radius:16px; overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--lk-line); background: #ffffff;
      box-shadow:none;
      transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-card:hover {
      transform:none;
      box-shadow:none;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-img {
      position: relative; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-img img {
      width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
      transition: transform 0.3s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-card:hover .tv-blog-guide-img img {
      transform: scale(1.02);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-img .tv-blog-img-fallback-lg {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--lk-teal) 0%, var(--lk-teal) 100%);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-img .tv-blog-guide-overlay {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: rgba(16,32,51,0.06);
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-card:hover .tv-blog-guide-overlay {
      background: rgba(16,32,51,0);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-body {
      padding: 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.75rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-body { padding: 1.75rem 2rem 2rem; }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-title {
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem); font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-practical .tv-blog-guide-excerpt {
      margin-top: 0.75rem;
      font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--lk-muted);
    }
    /* ============================================================
       MODULE 4 — EDITORIAL METHOD SPOTLIGHT
    ============================================================ */
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial {
      background: #eef6f6;
      padding-block: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-grid {
      display: grid; gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem); align-items: center;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; gap: clamp(3rem, 5vw, 5rem);
      }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-visual {
      display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-panel {
      border-radius:16px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;
      background: var(--lk-navy);
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-panel:last-child {
      margin-top: 3rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
      #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-panel:last-child { margin-top: 3.5rem; }
    }
    #tv-blog-index-v1 #tv-blog-editorial .tv-blog-editorial-panel-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,36,57,0.9) 0%, rgba(15,107,105,0.72) 100%);
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; padding: 1.25rem;
    }

  <!-- ============================================================
       MODULE 1 — BLOG MASTHEAD
  ============================================================ -->
  <div id="tv-blog-masthead">
    <div class="tv-blog-container">
      <div class="tv-blog-masthead-grid">
        <div class="lc-block">
          <p class="tv-blog-masthead-eyebrow">Linker Journal</p>
          <h1 class="tv-blog-masthead-title">
            Read before you size, pair or quote.
          </h1>
          <p class="tv-blog-masthead-lead">
            Articles on system sizing, inverter-battery pairing, commissioning and monitoring, written for installers and EPCs who carry the project after handover.
          </p>
          <div class="tv-blog-masthead-chips">
            <span class="tv-blog-chip">Hybrid inverters</span>
            <span class="tv-blog-chip">Battery sizing</span>
            <span class="tv-blog-chip">Commissioning</span>
            <span class="tv-blog-chip">Monitoring</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div>
          <form role="search" method="get" action="/" class="lc-block">
            <input type="hidden" name="post_type" value="post">
            <label for="tv-blog-search" class="sr-only">Search articles</label>
            <div class="tv-blog-search">
              <input id="tv-blog-search" type="search" name="s" placeholder="Find technical articles">
              <button type="submit" aria-label="Search">
                <svg aria-hidden="true" class="h-5 w-5" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8">
                  <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="m21 21-4.35-4.35m1.85-5.15a7 7 0 1 1-14 0 7 7 0 0 1 14 0Z" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ============================================================
       MODULE 2 — LATEST ARTICLES SPLIT
  ============================================================ -->
  <div id="tv-blog-latest">
    <div class="tv-blog-container">
      <div class="tv-blog-latest-grid">
        <div>
          <div class="lc-block">
            <p class="tv-blog-mono-eyebrow">/ Latest reading</p>
            <h2 class="tv-blog-section-heading">Latest articles</h2>
          </div>

          <loop type="post" count="1" orderby="date" order="desc">
            <article class="lc-block">
              <a href="/{Field name}/" class="tv-blog-featured-card" style="display: block; text-decoration: none;">
                <div class="tv-blog-featured-img">
                  <if field="image">
                    <img src="{Field image_url size='large'}" srcset="{Field image_srcset}" sizes="{Field image_sizes}" loading="eager" alt="{Field image_alt}">
                    <else>
                      <div class="tv-blog-img-fallback">
                        <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 6.042A8.967 8.967 0 0 0 6 3.75c-1.052 0-2.062.18-3 .512v14.25A8.987 8.987 0 0 1 6 18c2.305 0 4.408.867 6 2.292m0-14.25a8.966 8.966 0 0 1 6-2.292c1.052 0 2.062.18 3 .512v14.25A8.987 8.987 0 0 0 18 18a8.967 8.967 0 0 0-6 2.292m0-14.25v14.25" /></svg>
                      </div>
                    </else>
                  </if>
                </div>
                <div class="tv-blog-featured-body">
                  <div class="tv-blog-featured-meta">
                    <field name="publish_date" date_format="M j, Y"></field>
                    <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                    <loop type="taxonomy_term" taxonomy="category" post="current" count="1">
                      <span class="tv-blog-card-cat-mono"><field name="title"></field></span>
                    </loop>
                  </div>
                  <h3 class="tv-blog-featured-title"><field name="title"></field></h3>
                  <div class="tv-blog-featured-excerpt">
                    <field name="excerpt" auto="true" words="28" more="..."></field>
                  </div>
                  <span class="tv-blog-featured-link">Read article
                    <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" style="width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem;">
                      <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" />
                    </svg>
                  </span>
                </div>
              </a>
            </article>
          </loop>
        </div>

        <aside>
          <div class="lc-block">
            <h2 class="tv-blog-section-heading">More from the journal</h2>
          </div>
          <loop type="post" count="4" offset="1" orderby="date" order="desc" class="tv-blog-compact-list">
            <article class="lc-block">
              <a href="/{Field name}/" class="tv-blog-compact-item">
                <div>
                  <div class="tv-blog-card-cat-mono-muted">
                    <loop type="taxonomy_term" taxonomy="category" post="current" count="1">
                      <field name="title"></field>
                    </loop>
                  </div>
                  <h3 class="tv-blog-compact-title"><field name="title"></field></h3>
                </div>
                <span class="tv-blog-compact-arrow">
                  <svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" style="width: 1rem; height: 1rem;">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6" />
                  </svg>
                </span>
              </a>
            </article>
          </loop>
        </aside>
      </div>

      <div class="lc-block tv-blog-inquiry-strip">
        <div class="tv-blog-inquiry-inner">
          <div>
            <span class="tv-blog-inquiry-label">When the reading turns into a project.</span><span class="tv-blog-inquiry-text" style="margin-left: 0.5rem;">Send the project data. The team reviews the technical solution, availability and the next steps.</span>
          </div>
          <a href="/request-a-project/" class="tv-blog-btn-primary">Request a project<svg aria-hidden="true" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" style="width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem;">
              <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M7 17 17 7m0 0H9m8 0v8" />
            </svg>
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

      function appendBrowseAnchor(anchor) {
        if (!(anchor instanceof HTMLAnchorElement)) return;
        var href = anchor.getAttribute('href');
        if (!href) return;
        if (href.indexOf('#') === -1) {
          anchor.setAttribute('href', href + '#tv-blog-browse');
        }
      }
      var pagination = root.querySelector('.tv-blog-pagination');
      if (pagination) {
        var links = pagination.querySelectorAll('a');
        for (var i = 0; i < links.length; i++) {
          appendBrowseAnchor(links[i]);
        }
      }
      var hashTarget = window.location.hash;
      if (hashTarget === '#tv-blog-browse') {
        browse.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'auto', block: 'start' });
      } else if (window.location.search.indexOf('paged=') > -1 || window.location.pathname.indexOf('/page/') > -1) {

<style data-site-css="contact-journal.css">
