<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

</script>

 if(existing)attach(existing);
 else{var waiting=new MutationObserver(function(){var node=mount.querySelector('.linker-contact');if(node){waiting.disconnect();attach(node);}});waiting.observe(mount,{childList:true});}
 mobile.addEventListener('change',function(){adaptPage();layout();});
 adaptPage();

 var stories=Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.cp-story details'));
 if(stories.length){
  stories[0].open=!mobile.matches;
  mobile.addEventListener('change',function(){stories.forEach(function(item,i){item.open=!mobile.matches&&i===0;});});
  stories.forEach(function(item){item.addEventListener('toggle',function(){if(item.open)stories.forEach(function(other){if(other!==item)other.open=false;});});});
 }
})();

</script>
<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

</script>

<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

</script>

/* Local prototype: reuse the accepted Utility photo dock on three mobile chapters.
   Existing text, panels and desktop controls remain the source of each topic. */
(function () {
  var mobile = window.matchMedia('(max-width:800px)');
  var configurations = [
    {root:'#about-journal #pillars>.wrap', head:'.section-head', items:'.c-backbone-text>article', title:'h3', image:'.c-small-photo img', key:'about'},
    {root:'#service-redesign .service-intro', head:'.lk-section-head', items:'[data-capability-card]', title:'.lk-trust-val', key:'service', images:[
      '/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/linker-packed-and-dispatched-as-one.webp',
      '/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/linker-grid-documents-for-the-order.webp',
      '/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/linker-commissioning-guidance-from-linker.webp',
      '/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/linker-warranty-handled-in-germany-scaled.webp'
    ]},
    {root:'#tv-solutions-developers-v1 #desk>.lk-container', head:'.lk-section-head', items:'.lk-desk-tab-pane', title:'.lk-desk-h3', image:'.lk-desk-visual-frame img', native:'.lk-desk-tab-btn', key:'epc'}
  ];
  configurations.forEach(function (config) {
    var root = document.querySelector(config.root);
    if (!root) return;
    var items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(config.items));
    var nativeButtons = config.native ? Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(config.native)) : [];
    var photos = items.map(function(item,i){return config.images ? config.images[i] : item.querySelector(config.image).getAttribute('src');});
    var selected = 0;
    root.classList.add('mt-layout','mt-'+config.key);
    root.querySelector(config.head).classList.add('mt-heading');
    var visual = document.createElement('div');
    visual.className = 'mt-visual';
    visual.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    var photo = document.createElement('img');
    photo.alt = ''; photo.src = photos[0]; photo.className = 'mt-photo';
    visual.appendChild(photo); root.prepend(visual);
    var dock = document.createElement('div');
    dock.className = 'mt-dock';
    var buttons = items.map(function(item,i){
      item.classList.add('mt-topic');
      if (!item.id) item.id = 'mt-'+config.key+'-topic-'+i;
      var button = document.createElement('button');
      button.type = 'button';
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', nativeButtons[i] ? nativeButtons[i].textContent.trim() : item.querySelector(config.title).textContent.trim());
      button.setAttribute('aria-controls',item.id);
      var thumbnail = document.createElement('img');
      thumbnail.alt = ''; thumbnail.src = photos[i];
      var number = document.createElement('span');
      number.textContent = String(i+1).padStart(2,'0');
      number.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      number.setAttribute('data-prototype-duplicate','');
      button.append(thumbnail,number); dock.appendChild(button);
      return button;
    });
    dock.style.setProperty('--mt-count',String(items.length));
    root.appendChild(dock);
    function select(index) {
      selected = index;
      photo.src = photos[index];
      items.forEach(function(item,i){item.classList.toggle('mt-active',i===index);});
      buttons.forEach(function(button,i){button.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(i===index));});
      if (mobile.matches && nativeButtons[index]) nativeButtons[index].click();
    }
    buttons.forEach(function(button,i){
      button.addEventListener('click',function(){select(i);});
      button.addEventListener('mouseenter',function(){if(mobile.matches && window.matchMedia('(hover:hover)').matches)select(i);});
      button.addEventListener('keydown',function(event){
        if(!['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','Home','End'].includes(event.key))return;
        event.preventDefault();
        var next=event.key==='Home'?0:event.key==='End'?items.length-1:(i+(event.key==='ArrowRight'?1:items.length-1))%items.length;
        select(next); buttons[next].focus({preventScroll:true});
      });
    });
    nativeButtons.forEach(function(button,i){button.addEventListener('click',function(){selected=i;items.forEach(function(item,j){item.classList.toggle('mt-active',j===i);});photo.src=photos[i];buttons.forEach(function(b,j){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(j===i));});});});
    mobile.addEventListener('change',function(){if(mobile.matches)select(selected);});
    select(0);
  });
})();

</script>
<script data-site-js="site.js">
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var proto = {
    page: null,
    mounts: {},
    mount: function (name, fn) {
      this.mounts[name] = fn;
      if (typeof fn === "function") {
        fn(document);
      }
    }
  };

  window.LinkerPrototype = proto;

  function onReady(fn) {
    if (document.readyState === "loading") {
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", fn);
    } else {
      fn();
    }
  }

  onReady(function () {
    proto.page = document.body.getAttribute("data-page") || "";

    document.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      var link = event.target.closest("a[data-stub]");
      if (!link) {
        return;
      }
      event.preventDefault();
    });

    if (proto.page === "home") {
      initHome(document);
    }
  });

  function initHome(doc) {
    var root = doc.getElementById("home-study");
    if (!root) {
      return;
    }

    var disclosure = root.querySelector(".home-ops-info");
    if (disclosure) {
      doc.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (disclosure.open && !disclosure.contains(event.target)) {
          disclosure.open = false;
        }
      });
      disclosure.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape" && disclosure.open) {
          disclosure.open = false;
          var summary = disclosure.querySelector("summary");
          if (summary) {
            summary.focus();
          }
        }
      });
    }

    var stories = Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll(".home-story"));
    var prev = doc.getElementById("testi-prev");
    var next = doc.getElementById("testi-next");
    var storyIdx = 0;
    function goStory(idx) {
      if (!stories.length) {
        return;
      }
      storyIdx = (idx + stories.length) % stories.length;
      var target = stories[storyIdx];
      if (target && typeof target.scrollIntoView === "function") {
        target.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest", inline: "nearest" });
      }
    }
    if (prev) {
      prev.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx - 1);
      });
    }
    if (next) {
      next.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        goStory(storyIdx + 1);
      });
    }

    function lkAsk(message) {
      var text = (message || "").trim();
      if (!text) {
        return false;
      }
      try {
        window.dispatchEvent(
          new CustomEvent("lia:ask", { detail: { message: text } })
        );
        return true;
      } catch (e) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    var prompt = root.querySelector(".lk-dialog-prompt");
    var send = root.querySelector(".home-search .home-pill-primary");
    if (prompt && send) {
      send.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
        if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
          event.preventDefault();
          prompt.value = "";
        }
      });
      prompt.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
          if (lkAsk(prompt.value)) {
            event.preventDefault();
            prompt.value = "";
          }
        }
      });
    }
    Array.prototype.forEach.call(
      root.querySelectorAll("[data-lk-ask]"),
      function (cap) {
        cap.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
          if (lkAsk(cap.textContent)) {
            event.preventDefault();
          }
        });
      }
    );
  }
})();

</script>

<script>
(function() {
var root=document.getElementById('tv-cp-page-v1');if(!root){return;}
      // Testimonials Carousel
      var testiCards = root.querySelectorAll('.lk-story-card');
      var testiPills = root.querySelectorAll('.lk-testi-pill-bar');
      var testiPrev = document.getElementById('testi-prev');
      var testiNext = document.getElementById('testi-next');
      var testiCounter = document.getElementById('testi-counter');
      var currentTestiIdx = 0;
      var totalTestis = testiCards.length;
      function selectTestimonial(idx) {
        currentTestiIdx = idx;
        testiCards.forEach(function(c, i) {
          c.classList.toggle('active-center', i === idx);
        });
        testiPills.forEach(function(p, i) {
          p.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
        });
        if (testiCounter) testiCounter.textContent = (idx + 1) + ' / ' + totalTestis;
      }
      testiPills.forEach(function(pill) {
        pill.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial(parseInt(pill.getAttribute('data-index'), 10));
        });
      });
      testiCards.forEach(function(card) {
        card.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial(parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-index'), 10));
        });
      });
      if (testiPrev) {
        testiPrev.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial((currentTestiIdx - 1 + totalTestis) % totalTestis);
        });
      }
      if (testiNext) {
        testiNext.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial((currentTestiIdx + 1) % totalTestis);
        });
      }
  var lkTestiTrack=document.getElementById('testi-track');
  var lkTestiX=0;
  function lkTestiFollow(){
    if(!lkTestiTrack){return;}
    var vp=lkTestiTrack.parentElement;
    var active=lkTestiTrack.querySelector('.lk-story-card.active-center');
    if(!active){return;}
    var fits=lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth<=vp.clientWidth+2;
    if(fits){lkTestiX=0;lkTestiTrack.style.transform='';return;}
    var x=active.getBoundingClientRect().left-vp.getBoundingClientRect().left+lkTestiX;
    var max=lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth-vp.clientWidth;
    x=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(x),max));
    lkTestiX=x;
    lkTestiTrack.style.transition='transform .35s ease';
    lkTestiTrack.style.transform='translateX(-'+x+'px)';
  }
  if(lkTestiTrack){
    var lkTestiCtl=[document.getElementById('testi-prev'),document.getElementById('testi-next')]
      .concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.lk-testi-pill-bar, .lk-story-card')));
    lkTestiCtl.forEach(function(el){if(el){el.addEventListener('click',function(){setTimeout(lkTestiFollow,0);});}});
    window.addEventListener('resize',lkTestiFollow);
    if(lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth>lkTestiTrack.parentElement.clientWidth+2){
      var lkFirst=root.querySelector('.lk-story-card');
      if(lkFirst){lkFirst.click();}
    }
    lkTestiFollow();
  }
})();
</script>

#tv-cp-page-v1{margin:0;padding:0;font-family:var(--proto-font-sans);color:var(--proto-ink-deep);background:var(--proto-canvas);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#tv-cp-page-v1 *{box-sizing:border-box}
#tv-cp-page-v1 img{max-width:100%;display:block}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-container{width:min(1200px, calc(100% - 48px));margin:0 auto}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-container-wide{width:min(1360px, calc(100% - 48px));margin:0 auto}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-topbar{background:var(--proto-navy-deep);color:var(--proto-neutral-400);font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-topbar .lk-container{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-topbar a{color:var(--proto-neutral-300);text-decoration:none;transition:color 0.2s;font-weight:500}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-topbar a:hover{color:var(--proto-teal-500)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-pulse-status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--proto-teal-300);background:rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.12);border:1px solid rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.25);padding:3px 10px;border-radius:999px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-pulse-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--proto-teal-500);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--proto-teal-500)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap{position:relative;min-height:min(90vh, 840px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;overflow:hidden;background:var(--proto-navy-deep)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap-bg{position:absolute;inset:0}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap-bg img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 42%}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap-bg::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%, rgba(6, 19, 33, 0.58) 0%, rgba(6, 19, 33, 0.70) 58%, rgba(4, 12, 22, 0.88) 100%)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap-inner{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(940px, calc(100% - 48px));margin:0 auto;padding:120px 0 36px;text-align:center}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--proto-teal-300);margin-bottom:18px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap .lk-hero-h1{font-size:clamp(38px, 4.8vw, 64px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-0.035em;line-height:1.08;color:#ffffff;margin:0 0 20px;text-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-cap-desc{font-size:clamp(16px, 1.8vw, 19px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--proto-neutral-300);margin:0 auto 36px;max-width:720px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-btn-primary{background:var(--proto-teal-700);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:var(--proto-radius-md);text-decoration:none;transition:all 0.2s;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.28)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--proto-teal-400);transform:translateY(-2px)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-btn-secondary{background:rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);border:1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);color:#ffffff;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:var(--proto-radius-md);text-decoration:none;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:all 0.2s}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-btn-secondary:hover{background:rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);border-color:#ffffff}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-proof{position:relative;z-index:2;border-top:1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);background:rgba(4, 10, 18, 0.7);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding:18px 0;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:40px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--proto-neutral-400);flex-wrap:wrap}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-proof span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hero-proof b{color:var(--proto-teal-300);font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:14px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-trust-strip{background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--proto-line-journal);padding:36px 0}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-trust-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);gap:32px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-trust-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-left:2px solid var(--proto-line-journal);padding-left:20px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-trust-val{font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:var(--proto-navy-deep);margin-bottom:4px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-trust-lbl{font-size:13px;color:var(--proto-neutral-500);line-height:1.45}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-section{padding:96px 0}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-section-slate{background:var(--proto-neutral-50)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-section-head{margin-bottom:56px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-h2{font-size:clamp(30px, 3.5vw, 42px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-0.03em;color:var(--proto-navy-deep);margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.15}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-subtext{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--proto-ink-muted-deep);max-width:680px;line-height:1.6;margin:0}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4, 1fr);gap:24px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-card{background:#ffffff;border:1px solid var(--proto-line-journal);border-radius:var(--proto-radius-card);padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.03);transition:all 0.25s ease}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-card:hover{border-color:rgba(12,127,115,0.25);transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(19, 184, 166, 0.08)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-thumb{aspect-ratio:16 / 10;border-radius:var(--proto-radius-md);overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:var(--proto-navy-deep);margin-bottom:20px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-num{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(11, 31, 51, 0.9);color:var(--proto-teal-300);font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-kicker{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;color:var(--proto-teal-600);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.08em;margin-bottom:8px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-h3{font-size:18px;font-weight:800;color:var(--proto-navy-deep);margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.3}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-p{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--proto-ink-muted-deep);line-height:1.55;margin:0 0 16px;flex:1}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-deliverable{padding:12px;background:var(--proto-neutral-50);border-radius:var(--proto-radius-sm);border:1px solid var(--proto-line-journal);font-size:12px;color:var(--proto-ink-deep);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;line-height:1.45}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-check-deliverable strong{color:var(--proto-navy-deep)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-head{padding:88px 0 40px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-portrait{position:relative;min-height:480px;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;background-color:var(--proto-navy-deep);background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center right}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-portrait + .lk-hw-portrait{border-top:8px solid #ffffff}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-portrait::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.94) 0%, rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.72) 48%, rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.2) 80%, rgba(7, 14, 26, 0.05) 100%);pointer-events:none}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-p01{background-image:url(https://de-linker.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lk-about-lk-hw-p01-01-portrait.webp)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-p02{background-image:url(https://de-linker.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/lk-about-lk-hw-p02-02-portrait.webp)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-p03{background-image:url(https://de-linker.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/linker-container-bess-from-linker.webp)}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-hw-pbody{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:580px;padding:48px 0;color:#ffffff}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-brand-tag{font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--proto-teal-300);letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-brand-h3{font-size:clamp(26px, 2.8vw, 36px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-0.025em;color:#ffffff;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.15}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-brand-p{font-size:15px;color:var(--proto-neutral-300);line-height:1.6;margin:0 0 20px}
#tv-cp-page-v1 .lk-brand-chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:24px}

  <section class="lk-section lk-section-slate" id="faq">
    <div class="lk-container">
      <div class="lk-section-head" style="text-align: center;">
        <div class="lk-eyebrow" style="justify-content: center;">BEVOR SIE SICH AUF DIE HARDWARE FESTLEGEN</div>
        <h2 class="lk-h2">Die Fragen, die sich lohnen, bevor die Bestellung zum Problem auf der Baustelle wird.</h2>
        <p class="lk-subtext" style="margin: 0 auto;">Kompatibilität, Dokumentation und Projektanforderungen können von System zu System variieren. Dies sind einige der Fragen, die Kunden vor der endgültigen Festlegung der Ausrüstung an uns richten.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="lk-faq-list">
        <details class="lk-faq-item" open>
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Wie prüfe ich, ob eine Kombination aus Wechselrichter und Batteriespeicher geeignet ist?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Prüfen Sie die genauen Wechselrichter- und Batteriespeicher-Modelle anhand der technischen Informationen, die für diese Kombination verfügbar sind, einschließlich der hinterlegten Kompatibilitätsdokumentation und relevanter Kommunikationsanforderungen.
            <br><br>
            Die Kompatibilität sollte immer auf Modellebene geprüft werden und nicht allein anhand des Markennamens angenommen werden.
          </div>
        </details>
        <details class="lk-faq-item">
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Wie wird der Batteriespeicher vor der Bestellung dimensioniert?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Der Linker Planer dimensioniert den Batteriespeicher anhand von Lastprofil, Leistungsbedarf, gewünschter Speicherkapazität und vorgesehener Anwendung, die Sie eingeben, und wir stellen die hinterlegten Datenblätter und Kompatibilitätslisten bereit, damit Sie die Geräteauswahl eingrenzen können.
            <br><br>
            Die endgültige Systemauslegung und Installation bleiben in der Verantwortung der qualifizierten Fachkräfte, die für das Projekt verantwortlich sind.
          </div>
        </details>
        <details class="lk-faq-item">
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Was passiert, wenn die Firmware die Kommunikation zwischen Wechselrichter und Batteriespeicher beeinflusst?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Firmware kann das Kommunikationsverhalten und unterstützte Einstellungen beeinflussen. Wo relevante Informationen verfügbar sind, arbeiten wir mit der hinterlegten Dokumentation und den technischen Leitlinien für die gelieferte Ausrüstung.
            <br><br>
            Bei einer bestehenden Installation helfen uns das genaue Wechselrichtermodell, das Batteriespeichermodell und die Firmware-Versionen, das Problem schneller zu verstehen.
          </div>
        </details>
        <details class="lk-faq-item">
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Kann Linker Kombinationen liefern, die nicht auf einer hinterlegten Kompatibilitätsliste aufgeführt sind?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Eine Kombination, die nicht in den hinterlegten Kompatibilitätslisten steht, ist keine gelistete Kombination.
            <br><br>
            Nennen Sie uns die genauen Modelle, die Sie in Betracht ziehen, und wir senden Ihnen die für diese Kombination verfügbaren Unterlagen.
          </div>
        </details>
        <details class="lk-faq-item">
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Welche technischen Dokumente kann Linker bereitstellen?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Die Dokumentation variiert je nach Marke und Produkt. Vorliegende Dateien sind Datenblätter, Handbücher und Kompatibilitätsinformationen; Konformitätserklärungen und Einheitenzertifikate fordert Linker für das genaue Produkt an.
            <br><br>
            Wenn für Ihr Projekt ein bestimmtes Dokument erforderlich ist, teilen Sie uns dies vor der Bestellung mit, damit wir die Verfügbarkeit für das genaue Produkt prüfen können.
          </div>
        </details>
        <details class="lk-faq-item">
          <summary class="lk-faq-summary">Führt Linker Installation und endgültige Inbetriebnahme durch?</summary>
          <div class="lk-faq-body">
            Linker unterstützt die Ausrüstungsseite des Projekts, einschließlich Produktauswahl, technischer Informationen, Dokumentation und After-Sales-Koordination.
            <br><br>
            Elektroinstallation, Baustellen-Inbetriebnahme und die endgültige Verantwortung für den Netzanschluss verbleiben beim qualifizierten Auftragnehmer, der für die Installation verantwortlich ist.
          </div>
        </details>
      </div>

<script>
(function() {
var root=document.getElementById('tv-cp-page-v1');if(!root){return;}
      // Testimonials Carousel
      var testiCards = root.querySelectorAll('.lk-story-card');
      var testiPills = root.querySelectorAll('.lk-testi-pill-bar');
      var testiPrev = document.getElementById('testi-prev');
      var testiNext = document.getElementById('testi-next');
      var testiCounter = document.getElementById('testi-counter');
      var currentTestiIdx = 0;
      var totalTestis = testiCards.length;
      function selectTestimonial(idx) {
        currentTestiIdx = idx;
        testiCards.forEach(function(c, i) {
          c.classList.toggle('active-center', i === idx);
        });
        testiPills.forEach(function(p, i) {
          p.classList.toggle('active', i === idx);
        });
        if (testiCounter) testiCounter.textContent = (idx + 1) + ' / ' + totalTestis;
      }
      testiPills.forEach(function(pill) {
        pill.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial(parseInt(pill.getAttribute('data-index'), 10));
        });
      });
      testiCards.forEach(function(card) {
        card.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial(parseInt(card.getAttribute('data-index'), 10));
        });
      });
      if (testiPrev) {
        testiPrev.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial((currentTestiIdx - 1 + totalTestis) % totalTestis);
        });
      }
      if (testiNext) {
        testiNext.addEventListener('click', function() {
          selectTestimonial((currentTestiIdx + 1) % totalTestis);
        });
      }
  var lkTestiTrack=document.getElementById('testi-track');
  var lkTestiX=0;
  function lkTestiFollow(){
    if(!lkTestiTrack){return;}
    var vp=lkTestiTrack.parentElement;
    var active=lkTestiTrack.querySelector('.lk-story-card.active-center');
    if(!active){return;}
    var fits=lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth<=vp.clientWidth+2;
    if(fits){lkTestiX=0;lkTestiTrack.style.transform='';return;}
    var x=active.getBoundingClientRect().left-vp.getBoundingClientRect().left+lkTestiX;
    var max=lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth-vp.clientWidth;
    x=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(x),max));
    lkTestiX=x;
    lkTestiTrack.style.transition='transform .35s ease';
    lkTestiTrack.style.transform='translateX(-'+x+'px)';
  }
  if(lkTestiTrack){
    var lkTestiCtl=[document.getElementById('testi-prev'),document.getElementById('testi-next')]
      .concat(Array.prototype.slice.call(root.querySelectorAll('.lk-testi-pill-bar, .lk-story-card')));
    lkTestiCtl.forEach(function(el){if(el){el.addEventListener('click',function(){setTimeout(lkTestiFollow,0);});}});
    window.addEventListener('resize',lkTestiFollow);
    if(lkTestiTrack.scrollWidth>lkTestiTrack.parentElement.clientWidth+2){
      var lkFirst=root.querySelector('.lk-story-card');
      if(lkFirst){lkFirst.click();}
    }
    lkTestiFollow();
  }
})();
</script>
